rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No banned words (honest, delve, landscape-verb, importantly, crucial, substrate, leverage-verb, synergize, paradigm shift) found in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Ritual / ceremony — hard ban in any curriculum/training surface.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No ritual, ceremony, or practice-as-noun found in body (lines 1-62).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No dated session references, TODO annotations, or biographical narrative in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Voice spans AE101 quintet appropriately: Boris-flat facts (line 20), Sutherland reframe (line 11, 21), peer warmth throughout. No consultancy register or wrongly-elevated diction.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is an exercise, not an article.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No named technique or practitioner move is paraphrased in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Uses second-person consistently (line 9 "What you do", line 15 "your working tree", line 20 "Your rules files", line 55 "you have become"). No "the student" or teacher framing (keeper, trainer directives) in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No maintainer-only vocabulary (e.g. self-compound, grill-me, three-pattern) appears unearned in body. All terms are either earned through use or standard engineering vocabulary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reassurance-shaped sentences (no penalty, fine way to, it's OK if, not a downgrade, etc.). Lines stay direct and actionable.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not a reference artefact.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No practitioner attribution in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 11 "send it off plainly and you find out what you can't steer yet" is punchy reframe with appropriate scope, no carve-out needed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No defensive-against-vendor, aspirational-frame, or consultancy-pap phrasing. All content is instructional and practical.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Feature branch, commit, short SHA, transcript path are industry-standard terms for AE101 engineer audience. No jargon planted ahead of earning context.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No dangling pronouns or vague spatial metaphors. Pronouns anchor clearly (line 55 "you have become the agent"). Actions stay concrete.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The **What happened:** block is OPTIONAL.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No What happened block present; exercise ends on final move (push prompt) rather than recap.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Verbs describing student→agent interaction are peer-flat or warmer: nudge (line 55), answer, correct, push back. No bark/order/command/whip/drag verbs.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Headers accurately name their sections: "Set the two return markers" (pins markers), "Pin the starting point" (creates commit), "Push it only if you want it off this laptop" (explains optional push), "Send it off" (sends task), "While it runs" (describes runtime activity).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No empty negation, deictic drumroll, bold-label echo, or citation duplication. Prose is lean and direct.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Numerals (3 "12 minutes", line 17 "5 min", line 47 "7 min") are timing labels, not redundant with adjacent lists.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing — run the truth test before reaching for §12.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No superlatives or broad claims that require truth-testing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A claim binds to every body that states it, not just the one holding the stamp.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No claims repeated across multiple files in scope here.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Single-file evaluation; rule set staleness is a multi-file sweep issue.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 11 reframes send-off as discovery ("you find out what you can't steer yet"), not as correction or gap-filling.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Technical terms (feature branch, commit, short SHA, transcript path) are standard engineering vocabulary for AE101 audience. No earning debt.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule applies to Agents 101 (buyer-facing). This is AE101 (engineer audience).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 20 uses "memory" correctly (persistent artifact). No context/memory conflation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body — THIS RULE HAS AN EXCEPTION; read to the boundary before cutting anything.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No troubleshooting or recovery branches in body. All content follows golden path.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule governs prompt shape, not body prose.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Already evaluated under check_writing.md rule 7. Consistent second-person throughout; no "the student" or teacher-POV directives.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Already evaluated under check_writing.md rule 8. No maintainer vocabulary leaking into body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Already evaluated under check_writing.md rule 9. No reassurance-shaped sentences.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No simulation exercise in this file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No "What research says" callout boxes.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No research callout boxes in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lines 53-55 direct student to keep laptop awake and nudge the agent (in-chat moves). All actions stay within conversation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This exercise does not ask student to write or author CLAUDE.md. The prompts (in fenced blocks, exempt from body rules) mention CLAUDE.md layers.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No em-dashes in body. Sentences use commas and parentheses for subclauses.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 54: "## While it runs" lacks a command verb. All other headers use imperative verbs (Set, Pin, Push, Send). This section is about doing (keeping laptop awake, nudging agent) and should lead with a command verb.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Rewrite as a command verb: "Keep the session alive while it runs" or similar imperative form.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No cross-references to other curriculum surfaces in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives on first student-authored use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No shared-word collisions arise in this body (e.g. no authoring of memory, skill, rule, plan in this exercise).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 22 "Claude Code writes", line 24 "Ask Claude", line 49 "Ask Claude to run", line 55 "the agent runs" — uses Claude for product/invocation, agent for autonomous work. Correct.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Session / task / run split.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lines 5, 22, 24, 49 use session/task/run correctly: session = one sitting, task = work item, run = CI execution/agent sitting.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No tomorrow/overnight/this morning/tonight anchors. Line 53 "Keep the laptop awake and plugged in" is setting, not time-of-day phrasing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No "Pause", "Meta-moment", "Step back", or contemplative-pause headers. Line 55 directs action, not labelled as reflection.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No meta-ask when student has already decided.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No meta-ask structure in this exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: `.md` is default file type for student artifacts across curriculum.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Meta rule; not applicable to body prose evaluation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All content advances the exercise goal. No implementation detail, admin aside, or trivial caveat without forward function.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body "read it" / "look at it" / "notice X" after chat-print = dead weight.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No chat-print artifacts described in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No forward-looking asides or callouts in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No operational settings (model, mode, path convention) established here for later re-reminder.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Echo the training's theory spine before inventing a synonym.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 20 uses "rules files, memory, ADRs, skills" (AE101 vocabulary). Line 55 uses "agent" (house term). No invented synonyms.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the artifact, not the act.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 31 names "the commit" and "the transcript path" (artifacts), not typing/writing acts. Line 49 names "the scoped task".

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the outcome; don't walk a professional through trivial mechanics.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 53 states outcome (laptop awake) + mechanism in parenthetical for AE101 audience who needs to know HOW to prevent sleep.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The curriculum does not narrate itself — subject test, then deletion test.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No arc-positioning prose ("this training is...", "the module does..."). All content is about student's repo, agent, task, artifacts.
